ABox role

  • CURIE: gmeow:boxABox
  • Doctrine: Four Boxes doctrine

Assertional graph role: concrete instance data, examples, claims, and payload triples that are validated, transported, projected, or reasoned over by GMEOW tooling.

gmeow:actionAcceptTracking individual accept tracking Accept that use of the asset may be tracked (odrl:acceptTracking).
gmeow:actionAggregate individual aggregate Use the asset within an aggregation with other assets (odrl:aggregate).
gmeow:actionAnnotate individual annotate Add explanatory notations to the asset (odrl:annotate).

gmeow:actionConcurrentUse individual concurrent use Permit a limited number of concurrent uses (odrl:concurrentUse).

gmeow:actionSell individual sell Transfer ownership of the asset in return for payment (odrl:sell).

gmeow:actionStream individual stream Deliver the asset as a real-time stream (odrl:stream).
gmeow:actionSynchronize individual synchronize Use the asset in timed relation with another asset (odrl:synchronize).

gmeow:lossDropsDynamics individual loss: drops dynamics Dynamic markings (loudness, accent, articulation) are not encoded in the notation.
gmeow:lossDropsInstrumentation individual loss: drops instrumentation The specific instrument set or instrumentation is not encoded in the notation.
gmeow:lossDropsMicrotiming individual loss: drops microtiming Systematic timing deviations (swing, groove, Dilla feel) are not encoded as explicit frame-relative offsets.
gmeow:lossDropsPerformerCount individual loss: drops performer count The number of performers or voices is not explicitly encoded in the notation.
gmeow:lossDropsSpatialSoundContext individual loss: drops spatial/sound context The environmental sound content or spatial location of musical events is not encoded in the notation.
gmeow:lossDropsSpectralDerivation individual loss: drops spectral derivation The spectral source of pitch collections is discarded; only a subset of derived pitches is encoded.
gmeow:lossDropsTacet individual loss: drops tacet The explicit instruction that a part is silent (tacet) is not separately encoded in the notation.
gmeow:lossDropsTimbre individual loss: drops timbre Timbre, playing technique, and instrument-specific tone colour are not encoded in the symbolic content.
gmeow:lossDropsTraversalConstraints individual loss: drops traversal constraints Mobile-form traversal rules are not representable; only one realized sequence can be encoded.
gmeow:lossDropsTuningFrame individual loss: drops tuning frame The explicit TuningSystem reference is lost; only local accidental symbols or pitch-class numbers remain.
gmeow:lossQuantizesPitchTo12Edo individual loss: quantizes pitch to 12-EDO The notation can only represent 12-equal-division-of-the-octave pitch classes; other tuning frames are approximated or unrepresentable.
gmeow:lossQuantizesTimeToRationalGrid individual loss: quantizes time to a rational grid The notation represents time as a hierarchy of rational note values under a single meter and tempo; continuous tempo maps and irrational ratios are approximated.
gmeow:lossSymbolizesContinuousTrajectory individual loss: symbolizes continuous trajectory Continuous pitch trajectories (glissandi, portamenti, UPIC shapes) are reduced to discrete note symbols or graphic approximations.
gmeow:maximViolationManner individual maxim violation — manner Violation of the Gricean maxim of Manner: avoid obscurity, ambiguity, prolixity, and disorder. Distortion, spin, and deliberate obfuscation violate this maxim.
gmeow:maximViolationQuality individual maxim violation — quality Violation of the Gricean maxim of Quality: do not say what you believe to be false or for which you lack adequate evidence. Lies, falsifications, and bullshit violate this maxim.
gmeow:maximViolationQuantity individual maxim violation — quantity Violation of the Gricean maxim of Quantity: make your contribution as informative as required, but not more so. Omissions, concealment, and paltering violate this maxim.
gmeow:maximViolationRelation individual maxim violation — relation Violation of the Gricean maxim of Relation (Relevance): be relevant. Paltering and certain forms of distraction or red-herring deception violate this maxim.

gmeow:notationABC individual ABC notation A text-based music notation format popular in folk music and LLM-native interchange. Monophonic-biased and nonstandard for microtones.

gmeow:notationHEJI individual Helmholtz-Ellis JI Pitch Notation A just-intonation staff notation using symbols for prime-number comma alterations above or below a note.
gmeow:notationJianpu individual Jianpu A numbered musical notation system widely used in Chinese-language music practice.
gmeow:notationJohnstonJI individual Ben Johnston just-intonation notation A staff notation for just intonation using accidentals to indicate prime-limit comma alterations (e.g. +7, -5).
gmeow:notationKern individual Humdrum **kern The Humdrum **kern symbolic music representation. 12-TET letter-pitch bias; designed for musicology pipelines.
gmeow:notationKlavarskribo individual Klavarskribo A vertical-staff keyboard notation system that represents notes as black and white bars.
gmeow:notationLilyPond individual LilyPond The LilyPond text-based engraving format. Program-not-data: executable layout macros are lost when read as pure symbolic data.
gmeow:notationMEI individual MEI The Music Encoding Initiative XML format. Richer than MusicXML for CMN, mensural, neumes, and tablature; still lossy for tuning frames, JI lattices, and mobile forms.

gmeow:notationMensural individual Mensural notation Medieval and Renaissance mensural notation with its own time semantics (proportions, coloration, perfection).
gmeow:notationMusicXML individual MusicXML The W3C MusicXML 4.0 symbolic music interchange format. Lossy: microtones via bare decimal alter, polymeter via implementation-dependent hacks, no mobile-form traversal semantics.

gmeow:pitchSpellingCSharp4CMN individual C♯4 in CMN The CMN spelling "C♯4" for the 12-EDO pitch value at degree 1.

gmeow:pitchValue24EDOG4 individual 24-EDO G4 The 24-EDO pitch value G4 (700 cents).
